<function name="SetHoldPos" parent="DVerticalDivider" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
<internal></internal>
Sets the local Y position of where the user starts dragging the divider.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="y" type="number">The local Y position where divider dragging has started.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
